theirReference: Cristian is a super kind host. Even before we arrived, he already sent us tips about places to visit and food to eat. He welcomed us and let us sleep in after a red-eye flight which was highly appreciated. We get to have our own room and a comfortable bathroom to use. His mum shared food with us, which made us feel so welcomed. We also hanged out with Cristian and his girlfriend, and he showed us his favourite places to get food, which was super cool. Cristian is very thoughtful and he has organised the room for couchsurfers in a very clear and friendly way. Highly recommended. Cristian, all the best with your future travels! Our visit to Bogotá wouldn’t have been the same without you!
myReference: I had the pleasure of hosting Emily and her husband in Bogotá, and it was a truly wonderful experience. We went out for a walk together and enjoyed exploring Colombian gastronomy — they even tried chicha, a traditional local drink! They also prepared a delicious Asian dish that I really enjoyed. Both of them are very respectful, clean, organized, and incredibly kind. They are open-minded, polite, and easy to get along with. I definitely recommend them to any host or traveler and would be happy to meet them again in the future! Enjoy South America guys 🤗 anytime you wanna come back you are more than welcome ✨
